meta.principle: Precision over recall. A URL is VERIFIED only if a content check confirms it is (1) a real medical-necessity policy/criteria document (not a search page, code list, benefit grid, or login wall), (2) contains actual criteria for the SPECIFIC procedure (indications + conservative care/PT/imaging), (3) is current (not superseded), and (4) is public. Anything else is not trusted.

https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/7.note: Aetna CPB 0743; real 6-week conservative-care criteria quoted for all three.

https://www.evicore.com/sites/default/fi.note: Cigna/eviCore CMM-311; 3-month conservative + KL grade criteria.

https://files.providernews.anthem.com/48.note: Anthem/Carelon Spine MSK03-1024.2; real criteria. Recheck for a 2025 revision.

https://files.providernews.anthem.com/25.note: Real criteria but dated 2023-11-05; must confirm this is the CURRENT Carelon version before trusting. Likely superseded by a 2025 guideline.

https://static.cigna.com/assets/chcp/pdf.note: Effective 2020, review 2021. Stale. Find the current Cigna cervical fusion policy.

https://www.uhcprovider.com/content/dam/.note: UHC 2026T0639I; the doc is real but criteria are outsourced to InterQual (proprietary, not in the public document).
TKA criteria outsourced to InterQual; ACL 29888 is only listed in the code table with no ACL criteria.

https://mcp.humana.com/tad/tad_new/Searc.note: Humana TAD search interface, not a policy document. ALL Humana mcp.humana.com/tad Search.aspx URLs are search pages -> reject.
